title: The Case for String Theory - Sixty Symbols
summary: Sixty Symbols interviews Nottingham cosmologist Tony Padilla, who says string theory deserves to be taken seriously. He explains how strings emerged from the equations rather than being invented.
why: It is cited in string theory arguments as a counterweight to critics, a working physicist's reason to think there is something to the theory.

quote.text: a professor explains why he at least believes there is something to it
